extra.reason: Fixed: sync now prompts before deleting any local branch with a pruned upstream, current or not, via a single bulk prompt (all/none/decide-per-branch) instead of a per-branch silent delete.

Implemented: global --json flag, output.rs JSON envelope helpers + prompt suppression, and full sync --json support (per-branch outcomes, deletion-candidate reporting without prompting, current-branch pull/merge outcome). Other commands panic with unimplemented!() on --json per explicit scope.

Implemented: sync now prints a grouped end-of-run summary (counts by outcome: fast-forwarded, up-to-date, deleted, deletion-candidate, kept, skipped, no-upstream) plus a reason line per skipped branch, in human mode only (json already carries structured per-branch data).

Implemented --delete-pruned (skips the pruned-branch bulk-deletion prompt and deletes all candidates, including under --json) alongside the previously-shipped --dry-run. Named specifically rather than a generic --yes per user feedback — more interaction points are expected later.

Fixed: the final status line now reflects all work done during the run (any branch fast-forwarded/deleted, or, under --dry-run, any that would be), not just current-branch pull/merge. Added 'Already up to date.' / 'Already up to date (dry run).' for the previously-silent nothing-to-do case.

Per-branch errors during fast-forward, pruned-status checks, and pruned-branch deletion are now caught and reported as a 'failed' BranchOutcome instead of aborting the loop via '?'. Summary/JSON output lists failed branches with reasons. Test added: branch_failure_does_not_abort_remaining_branches.
